ui.name: Phoenix
ui.title_cos: Magnus Title, Security Title, Pioneer Title, all in the Valley
ui.law: Arizona lets you assign a purchase contract. Since 2024 you must tell the seller in writing, before signing, that you may assign it. Never market the house itself.
ui.prefc: Tax lien: Maricopa sells liens every February on taxes a year or more late. Delinquent tax means the owner is on that list. State held means nobody bought the lien, the most distressed of all. The owner can still sell any time before a lien holder forecloses (3 years after the sale).
ui.buyers_note: Companies that bought 2 or more houses in the last 18 months, from the county sale data, most active first. Skip the big institutions and builders; the 2 to 20 purchase LLCs are the ones who buy wholesale deals. Look up the owner on the Arizona Corporation Commission and call.
ui.buyers_empty: No buyers found in the sale data yet.
ui.repairs: Repairs, Phoenix rough numbers per house: cosmetic 15-25k, kitchen+baths 30-50k, roof 12-20k, AC 8-14k, pool repair 5-15k, full gut 60-100k.
ui.sources: Maricopa County Assessor parcel layer (owner, mailing address, value, sale), Maricopa County delinquent tax and unsold lien parcel layers
